resources.string: Tap Start dictating. Say \"paragraph\", \"heading\", \"quote\" / \"end quote\", \"footnote\" / \"end footnote\", or \"end\" to finish and email.
Document exported — choose your email app to send.
Your dictation will appear here, formatted as it will look in the document.
Dictated with Voice Note. The formatted document is attached as .docx (opens in OnlyOffice, Word, LibreOffice).
Microphone permission is required to dictate.
No speech recognition service is available on this device.
